description: This file defines the 'Spots' class which extends the Basic class within a SuiteCRM module. It includes properties related to the database schema, methods for saving and processing configuration data, localization functions, and security interface implementation.

classes.name: Spots
classes.description: A model class representing the 'Spots' module, handling CRUD operations, configuration processing, and localization.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the class implements a specific interface, specifically returning true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields, including encoding configuration data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Spot object, processing the configuration data by translating labels to keys and vice versa.

methods.name: replaceKeyValueWithLabel
methods.description: Converts stored key identifiers in configuration JSON into human-readable labels for localization.

methods.name: getKeysForLabels
methods.description: Returns corresponding keys for a list of labels, ensuring correct translation mapping.

methods.name: logSpotsErrorWithKeyMatching
methods.description: Logs an error when label-to-key matching fails due to duplicates or mismatches.

methods.name: getKeyForLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the key(s) corresponding to a given label and spot type, facilitating translation.
